description: Look up the census tract for a US street address with the official US Census Bureau Geocoder. Returns the matched address, latitude and longitude, the 11-digit tract GEOID and tract number, block group and block GEOIDs, state and county FIPS, incorporated place, county subdivision, congressional district, state senate and house districts, urban area and combined statistical area. Use it for CRA, LIHTC, opportunity zone, grant eligibility and demographic lookups that start from an address.

address.description: One-line US address with house number, street, city and state or ZIP, for example "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500".

vintage.description: Census vintage. current (default) uses today's geographies; census2020 uses the 2020 Census geographies; acs2017 to acs2026 match an ACS release.

name: get_census_tract_for_address
title: Get census tract for an address
